name: ssh-explorer
description: WooSSH Explorer - a modern web file explorer and terminal for remote hosts over SSH

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ssh-explorer/server && npm run build --workspace @ssh-explorer/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop
scripts.app: npm run build:desktop && npm run start --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop
scripts.app:smoke: npm run build:desktop && npm run smoke --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop
scripts.app:e2e: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:dir --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop && node desktop/scripts/verify-desktop-e2e.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop
scripts.install-app: npm run dist && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/desktop/install.ps1
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspace @ssh-explorer/server && npm run test:e2e --workspace @ssh-explorer/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run test:web && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ssh-explorer/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @ssh-explorer/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @ssh-explorer/desktop

author: Andrew Woolfi | Андрей Павлов <zxcadsl@gmail.com>
